A Techmeme excerpt of Financial Times reporting describes a sharp Friday fall in the Nasdaq 100 and a larger weekly decline amid AI-investment concerns. The primary article was inaccessible.

The Nasdaq 100 is not the Nasdaq Composite, and a weekly percentage move is not the same interval as a single session. The excerpt does not independently establish why prices moved or provide a live quotation.
highlights: Evidence is an indexed report excerpt
Nasdaq indexes must not be conflated
